body:
Founder real-time: 'i dont know why this never moved forward i kept asking for doors please make doors actually work.' Real, confirmed root cause: doorsForExport always emitted a script_url even at ScriptID 0, a guaranteed 404. ScriptID 0 now leaves script_url empty, the real signal SHANKPIT's own native loader reads as 'use the builtin proximity-open default' instead of a doomed fetch. New regression test. Commits: c45ebaa, 8b5a8ce.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed doors: ScriptID 0 no longer emits a doomed script_url
